THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My No.: HR/LD/3/1/514. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following land for a public purpose mentioned below: The particulars of the land intend to acquire: The allotments of the land 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 and 11 of the supplementary land particulars list and depicted in the preliminary plan bearing No. P.P. No. 4698 dated 05.04.2024 of Survey General situated in the Village of Ovitiyagala and Aramanagolla of Aramanagolla Grama Niladhari Division No. 610A in the Divisional Secretary's Division, Horana in the District of Kalutara, Western Province. All persons interested in the aforesaid land, rights or other relationships, are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat, Horana at 10.00 a.m. on the 24th day of February 2025. Further all persons are hereby requested to inform me in writing with two copies on or before 17th day of February 2025, the nature of their interest regarding the said lands, the particulars of their claims for the compensation of the said lands and the method of the calculation of such amount.
